core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; OTC Healthcare; Health and Beauty Products; Diagnostics; Primary Care Services
specialty_focus: Goodlife Pharmacy is a retail pharmacy chain in Kenya and Uganda, operating nearly 150 pharmacy and health hubs. It provides prescription medicines, over-the-counter drugs, health and beauty products, diagnostics, and primary care consultations, with services such as immunization, health screenings, and chronic disease management. It is not a wearable medical device specialist.
